sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99% Invisible。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗马·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When a Brazilian soccer player scores a goal, the announcer starts slow.
sentences.zh: 当巴西足球运动员进球时，解说员的声音由慢及快。

sentences.en: And it builds.
sentences.zh: 层层递进。

sentences.en: Until it reaches a glorious crescendo.
sentences.zh: 直到达到辉煌的最高潮。

sentences.en: They do this all over the world now, but it started in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 现在世界各地都在这么做，但它起源于巴西。

sentences.en: And there's something particularly triumphant about it there.
sentences.zh: 而且那里有着一种格外令人欢欣鼓舞的氛围。

sentences.en: That's producer Joe Sykes.
sentences.zh: 那是制作人乔·赛克斯。

sentences.en: That's because soccer means so much to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 那是因为足球对巴西意义重大。

sentences.en: How can I explain what soccer means to Brazilians without sounding corny?
sentences.zh: 我该如何向巴西人解释足球的意义，才不会显得老土呢？

sentences.en: But I think I'm going to have to sound corny, okay?
sentences.zh: 但我想我免不了要显得老土了，好吗？

sentences.en: That's Fernando Duarte, a BBC journalist who wrote a book about Brazilian soccer.
sentences.zh: 那是费尔南多·杜阿尔特，一位写过巴西足球书籍的BBC记者。

sentences.en: Soccer, or football as I call it, being British, arrived in Brazil in the late 19th century.
sentences.zh: 足球（由于我是英国人，我也叫它football）于19世纪后期传入巴西。

sentences.en: At first it was a game played in elite circles and in cities.
sentences.zh: 起初，它是一项在精英圈子和城市里开展的运动。

sentences.en: But poor and working-glass Brazilians struggled to make the game their own.
sentences.zh: 但贫穷和工人阶级的巴西人努力让这项运动成为他们自己的东西。

sentences.en: The only time the elites were robbed or they were deprived of something by the poor people
sentences.zh: 精英阶层被穷人掠夺或剥夺某些东西的唯一一次，

sentences.en: or by the common folk is when football ceased to be a game for the elites and it became a
sentences.zh: 或者说被普通百姓剥夺的唯一一次，是足球不再是精英的专属游戏，而成为了一项

sentences.en: mass sport.
sentences.zh: 大众运动。

sentences.en: Soccer eventually became so popular and beloved in Brazil that their national team's soccer
sentences.zh: 足球最终在巴西变得如此受欢迎且深得人心，以至于他们国家队的足球

sentences.en: jersey has become as much a national symbol as the country's flag.
sentences.zh: 球衣已经成为了与国旗同等重要的国家象征。

sentences.en: You're going to see many more people in Brazil wearing the shirt than waving the flag.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，你会看到更多的人穿球衣，而不是挥舞国旗。

sentences.en: It's a sense of belonging.
sentences.zh: 这是一种归属感。

sentences.en: No matter if you were, you know, peanuts picking up old soda cans
sentences.zh: 不管你是在街上捡旧苏打罐的社会底层，

sentences.en: on the street or if you were a millionaire, when you wear that shirt you're just like one of us.
sentences.zh: 还是百万富翁，当你穿上那件球衣时，你就和我们一样。

sentences.en: Those shirts are extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 那些球衣太非同凡响了。

sentences.en: They are scintillating.
sentences.zh: 它们光彩夺目。

sentences.en: In fact, I think the word is coruscating.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得用“灿烂夺目”这个词最合适。

sentences.en: That's the soccer writer and historian David Gobla.
sentences.zh: 那是足球作家兼历史学家大卫·戈布拉。

sentences.en: There are flashes of diamond light coming off of those shirts.
sentences.zh: 那些球衣上仿佛散发着钻石般的光芒。

sentences.en: The Brazilian soccer shirts are so iconic that non-soccer fans all over the world can often
sentences.zh: 巴西的足球球衣是如此具有标志性，以至于世界各地的非球迷往往也能

sentences.en: picture them.
sentences.zh: 脑海中浮现出它们的模样。

sentences.en: But for those of you who can't, the shirt is a bright canary yellow with green
sentences.zh: 但对于那些想象不出来的人，这件球衣是亮金丝雀黄的，带有

sentences.en: trim around the collar and sleeves.
sentences.zh: 领口和袖口周围的绿色镶边。

sentences.en: They're worn with blue shorts, a pure primary blue.
sentences.zh: 它们搭配蓝色的短裤，纯粹的原生蓝色。

sentences.en: Compared with other soccer jerseys, the uniform is joyful and bold.
sentences.zh: 与其他足球球衣相比，这套队服充满活力且极为大胆。

sentences.en: It seems to capture something
sentences.zh: 它似乎捕捉到了

sentences.en: essential about Brazil.
sentences.zh: 巴西的精髓。

sentences.en: But it wasn't always this way.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: In fact, Brazil used to play in plain,
sentences.zh: 事实上，巴西过去穿的是素净、

sentences.en: unremarkable white shirts.
sentences.zh: 不起眼的白色球衣。

sentences.en: The story of how the uniform changed goes back 70 years to an epic soccer game that
sentences.zh: 这套队服演变的故事可以追溯到70年前的一场史诗级足球赛，

sentences.en: Brazilians will never forget.
sentences.zh: 那是巴西人永远不会忘记的比赛。

sentences.en: After years of lobbying, the World Cup arrived in Brazil in 1950.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的游说，世界杯于1950年登陆巴西。

sentences.en: At the time, the country was
sentences.zh: 当时，这个国家在

sentences.en: culturally and internationally kind of unknown.
sentences.zh: 文化和国际上可以说是默默无闻。

sentences.en: This was Brazil's big moment to show the world
sentences.zh: 这是巴西向世界展示

sentences.en: world what it was made of.
sentences.zh: 自己真正实力的重大时刻。

sentences.en: The 1950 World Cup was understood by the Brazilian population as an
sentences.zh: 1950年世界杯被巴西人民视为一个

sentences.en: opportunity to say to the world, Brazil has arrived.
sentences.zh: 向世界宣告巴西已经崛起的契机。

sentences.en: They knew this World Cup was their chance to tell everyone.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这届世界杯是他们向所有人宣告的机会。

sentences.en: We have modernised, we have been transformed, we've moved from being an agricultural plantation
sentences.zh: 我们已经现代化了，我们已经蜕变了，我们已经从一个农业种植园

sentences.en: economy to a new urban industrialised economy.
sentences.zh: 经济转变为一个新的城市工业化经济。

sentences.en: And this is our way of showing it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们展示这一点的方式。

sentences.en: The main symbol of that coming out, apart from what was happening on the soccer field,
sentences.zh: 除了球场上发生的事情之外，这种亮相的主要象征

sentences.en: was the stadium named the Maracanar in Rio de Janeiro.
sentences.zh: 就是位于里约热内卢的马拉卡纳体育场。

sentences.en: It looks like the stadium from outer space.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是一个来自外太空的体育场。

sentences.en: I mean, it is this fabulous, flat, white concrete
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个美妙、平坦、白色的混凝土

sentences.en: oval with amazing flying buttresses.
sentences.zh: 椭圆形建筑，带有令人惊叹的飞扶壁。

sentences.en: Just like this huge flying saucer that had dropped down in the centre of the city.
sentences.zh: 就像一个巨大的飞碟降落在市中心一样。

sentences.en: But done with this sort of incredible sort of modernist elegance.
sentences.zh: 但又带有那种不可思议的现代主义优雅感。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: it was the greatest stadium built since the Colosseum.
sentences.zh: 它是自古罗马斗兽场以来建造的最伟大的体育场。

sentences.en: So they had the stadium.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有了这座体育场。

sentences.en: The people were behind them.
sentences.zh: 民众支持他们。

sentences.en: The government was pushing the tournament
sentences.zh: 政府只要有机会

sentences.en: whenever possible.
sentences.zh: 就在大力推行这项赛事。

sentences.en: Now all they needed was a successful team.
sentences.zh: 现在他们只需要一支成功的球队。

sentences.en: The expectations were high because of this whole climate, this whole atmosphere of optimism.
sentences.zh: 由于这种整体氛围，这种完全乐观的氛围，人们的期望值很高。

sentences.en: In one of their earlier games, Brazil strode confidently onto the field in their white uniforms
sentences.zh: 在他们早期的比赛中，巴西队身着白色队服自信地走上球场，

sentences.en: and proceeded to demolish Sweden, 7-1.
sentences.zh: 并以7比1的悬殊比分彻底击溃了瑞典队。

sentences.en: Brazil were absolutely fantastic in the opening rounds.
sentences.zh: 巴西队在开局阶段的表现绝对棒极了。

sentences.en: They were slaughtering everybody that's
sentences.zh: 他们把所有对手都杀得片甲不留，

sentences.en: scoring goals all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都在进球。

sentences.en: They beat Spain 6-1.
sentences.zh: 他们以6比1击败了西班牙。

sentences.en: They also beat Mexico and Yugoslavia.
sentences.zh: 他们还击败了墨西哥和南斯拉夫。

sentences.en: The tournament was going exactly to plan.
sentences.zh: 比赛完全按计划进行。

sentences.en: It was this whole atmosphere of like sporting bliss.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一种洋溢着竞技之乐的氛围。

sentences.en: And all they had to do is get a draw of
sentences.zh: 他们只要在最后一场比赛中与

sentences.en: Uruguay in the last match.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭打平即可。

sentences.en: Because of a quirk in the tournament structure,
sentences.zh: 由于赛制上的一个巧合，

sentences.en: all Brazil had to do to win the World Cup was tie against Uruguay in their final game.
sentences.zh: 巴西想要赢得世界杯，只需在最后一场比赛中与乌拉圭战平即可。

sentences.en: Uruguay historically had been a really strong team, even though they're a tiny country,
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，乌拉圭一直是一支实力非常强劲的球队，尽管他们是一个极小的国家，

sentences.en: almost 50 times smaller than Brazil.
sentences.zh: 面积几乎比巴西小50倍。

sentences.en: But by the time this 1950 World Cup came along,
sentences.zh: 但到了1950年世界杯的时候，

sentences.en: Uruguay was a waning power in soccer.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭在足球界已经是一支实力走下坡路的强队了。

sentences.en: So beating them or at least tying them seemed totally doable,
sentences.zh: 所以击败他们，或者至少和他们打平，似乎完全做得到，

sentences.en: not a problem.
sentences.zh: 不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: Still, Uruguay was no pushover, especially when they were playing against
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，乌拉圭也不是好惹的，特别是当他们对阵

sentences.en: Brazil.
sentences.zh: 巴西的时候。

sentences.en: Uruguay actually used to be a Brazilian province.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭其实曾是巴西的一个省。

sentences.en: So they had this chip on their shoulder
sentences.zh: 所以对于他们这个年长、体量更大的邻居，

sentences.en: about their older, bigger next-door neighbor.
sentences.zh: 他们一直心存芥蒂。

sentences.en: The whole thing of being Uruguayan, going against the odds, fighting against an old colonial power,
sentences.zh: 作为乌拉圭人，顶住压力，与老牌殖民强权抗争的这种整体心态，

sentences.en: it spurred them on.
sentences.zh: 激励着他们不断前进。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the whole of Rio is now thinking about just one thing, the World Cup final.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，整个里约现在只想着一件事，那就是世界杯决赛。

sentences.en: There really is mass hysteria about it.
sentences.zh: 对此确实存在着一种集体歇斯底里。

sentences.en: Everybody knows about it.
sentences.zh: 人人都知道这件事。

sentences.en: Everyone's engaged with it.
sentences.zh: 所有人都参与其中。

sentences.en: Everyone wants to go.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想去现场。

sentences.en: No one can talk or think about anything else.
sentences.zh: 没有人能谈论或思考其他任何事情。

sentences.en: In Brazil, people like to say that if everybody who claimed to have been in the stadium that
sentences.zh: 在巴西，人们喜欢说，如果那天下午声称去过体育场的人

sentences.en: afternoon was actually there, the stadium would have needed to be the size of the moon.
sentences.zh: 真的都去了的话，那体育场得有月亮那么大才行。

sentences.en: And it was a big crowd.
sentences.zh: 那确实是人山人海。

sentences.en: Some estimate that there were 250,000 screaming fans packed into this
sentences.zh: 据估计，有25万名尖叫的球迷挤进了这座

sentences.en: Flying Saucer Stadium, which is something like 80,000 people over a capacity.
sentences.zh: 飞碟体育场，这比超载容量多了大约8万人。

sentences.en: And the players, when they walked out, were just hit with this wall of noise.
sentences.zh: 当球员们走出来时，迎面扑来的是犹如海啸般的声浪。

sentences.en: The place is noisy.
sentences.zh: 现场喧闹无比。

sentences.en: It is raucous.
sentences.zh: 极其嘈杂。

sentences.en: But in the first half, neither team scores.
sentences.zh: 但在上半场，双方均无建树。

sentences.en: So the crowd was getting nervous.
sentences.zh: 因此观众开始感到焦虑。

sentences.en: Everybody was getting tense.
sentences.zh: 每个人都开始紧张起来。

sentences.en: Then finally, Brazil scores a goal.
sentences.zh: 然后终于，巴西队进球了。

sentences.en: Just after halftime, a low shot across the goalkeeper into the bottom corner of the net.
sentences.zh: 就在中场休息后不久，一脚低射越过门将，直入球门底角。

sentences.en: And there's just this relief that surges all around the crowd.
sentences.zh: 整个观众席瞬间涌起一股如释重负的感觉。

sentences.en: Even the journalists run on and embrace the players.
sentences.zh: 甚至连记者都跑进场拥抱球员。

sentences.en: Because basically everyone there thinks the game is all over.
sentences.zh: 因为基本上那里的每个人都认为比赛已经结束了。

sentences.en: That Brazil has won the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 巴西已经赢得了世界杯。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但就在这时……

sentences.en: Uruguay scores.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭进球了。

sentences.en: About halfway through the second half.
sentences.zh: 大约在下半场进行到一半时。

sentences.en: The description by whoever was there is that the stadium felt very, very nervous.
sentences.zh: 当时在场的人的描述是，体育场的气氛变得非常非常紧张。

sentences.en: And this nervousness went to the players, almost like they were losing the game.
sentences.zh: 这种紧张情绪传染给了球员，几乎就像他们要输掉比赛一样。

sentences.en: And then comes the moment that everybody will always narrate.
sentences.zh: 接着便是每个人都会反复讲述的那个时刻。

sentences.en: How Cedis Jija, one of the Uruguayan wingers, gets the ball and dribbles down the right side toward the goal.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭边锋之一阿尔西德斯·吉贾如何拿球并沿右路带球冲向球门。

sentences.en: And just as he's looking up to pass the ball, he notices...
sentences.zh: 正当他抬头准备传球时，他注意到……

sentences.en: That the goalkeeper, Barbosa, was actually walking to try to anticipate a cross.
sentences.zh: 门将巴尔博萨其实正往前走，试图预判并截断传中。

sentences.en: Which meant Barbosa was out of position.
sentences.zh: 这意味着巴尔博萨失位了。

sentences.en: So instead of passing the ball, Jija shoots.
sentences.zh: 所以吉贾没有传球，而是直接起脚射门。

sentences.en: And scores.
sentences.zh: 球进了。

sentences.en: All of the reports talk about the most extraordinary silence in the stadium.
sentences.zh: 所有的报道都提到了体育场内那种非同寻常的寂静。

sentences.en: El Cedis Jija once said in his book, only three people in the history of the Maracanã silenced that crowd.
sentences.zh: 阿尔西德斯·吉贾曾在他的书中说过，马拉卡纳历史上只有三个人让那个球场鸦雀无声：

sentences.en: Frank Sinatra, Pope John Paul II, and me.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·辛纳屈、教皇若望·保罗二世和我。

sentences.en: It's almost like a graveyard.
sentences.zh: 简直就像墓地一样安静。

sentences.en: Some of the players don't even remember what happened.
sentences.zh: 有些球员甚至记不清发生了什么。

sentences.en: It was the state of Catatonia or something like that.
sentences.zh: 那是一种类似木僵的状态或者别的什么。

sentences.en: As you have probably guessed by now, Brazil does not manage to get another goal to tie the game.
sentences.zh: 正如你现在大概已经猜到的那样，巴西没能再进球扳平比分。

sentences.en: And Uruguay wins.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭赢了。

sentences.en: As the game ends, the fans stream out of the stadium and back onto the streets of Rio.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束时，球迷们涌出体育场，回到里约的街头。

sentences.en: It's almost like some kind of apocalypse happened and people just went somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像发生了某种世界末日，人们只是逃去了别的地方。

sentences.en: There was this feeling of solitude, this feeling of numbness.
sentences.zh: 有一种孤独感，有一种麻木感。

sentences.en: And Rio de Janeiro wasn't a party city on that night, on the night of July 16th, 1950.
sentences.zh: 在1950年7月16日那个夜晚，里约热内卢不再是一个狂欢的城市。

sentences.en: There was a lot of public crying.
sentences.zh: 有很多人在公开痛哭。

sentences.en: There's a lot of hyperbole.
sentences.zh: 有很多夸大其词的说法。

sentences.en: One Brazilian playwright calls the defeat Brazil's Hiroshima.
sentences.zh: 一位巴西剧作家将这场失利称为巴西的“广岛”。

sentences.en: All right, well, that's just ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这简直太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Which I think is both in bad taste and an exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 我认为这既没品味又过于夸张。

sentences.en: But people were really blown away.
sentences.zh: 但人们确实被彻底打懵了。

sentences.en: The recriminations came thick and faSt.
sentences.zh: 相互指责铺天盖地而来。

sentences.en: And soon, racist accusations started to fly.
sentences.zh: 很快，种族主义的指责也开始满天飞。

sentences.en: Barbosa, the guy who played goalkeeper for the Brazilians, was black.
sentences.zh: 巴尔博萨，那个为巴西队担任门将的人，是个黑人。

sentences.en: He and two other black players on the team were scapegoated in the popular press.
sentences.zh: 他和队里另外两名黑人球员在通俗小报上成了替罪羊。

sentences.en: And Barbosa was even hassled on the street.
sentences.zh: 甚至连巴尔博萨在街上都遭到刁难。

sentences.en: His life was made difficult.
sentences.zh: 他的生活变得举步维艰。

sentences.en: There's a tragic story he tells later in life of hearing a woman whispering to a child,
sentences.zh: 他晚年曾讲述过一个令人心碎的故事，说听到一个女人在对一个小孩子耳语：

sentences.en: This is the man who made all of Brazil cry.
sentences.zh: “这就是那个让整个巴西哭泣的人。”

sentences.en: After that, the Brazilian team didn't pick another black goalkeeper to start in the World Cup for over 50 years.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，巴西队在长达50多年的时间里，再也没有挑选过黑人门将作为世界杯的首发。

sentences.en: And this wasn't a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 这并非巧合。

sentences.en: After that game, black goalkeepers were regarded as less reliable than white ones in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 那场比赛之后，在巴西，黑人门将被认为不如白人门将可靠。

sentences.en: Which is disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人作呕。

sentences.en: But Barbosa wasn't the only focus of Brazilian blame.
sentences.zh: 但巴尔博萨并不是巴西人指责的唯一焦点。

sentences.en: In fact, everything about Brazilian soccer was scrutinized,
sentences.zh: 事实上，巴西足球的方方面面都遭到了审视，

sentences.en: down to the uniforms the players were wearing.
sentences.zh: 甚至细化到球员们身上穿的队服。

sentences.en: The authorities thought that the white shirt was cursed.
sentences.zh: 当局认为白衬衫是遭了诅咒的。

sentences.en: And I think everybody else in Brazil did.
sentences.zh: 我想巴西的其他所有人大概也都这么认为。

sentences.en: And above all, there was the determination never to play in white shirts again.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们下定决心再也不穿白色球衣比赛了。

sentences.en: It was pretty unusual for a team to completely transform their uniform.
sentences.zh: 对于一支球队来说，彻底改变他们的队服是相当罕见的。

sentences.en: Most countries have played in the same colors since the first World Cup back in the early 20th century.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪初的第一届世界杯以来，大多数国家一直穿着相同的颜色。

sentences.en: But the Brazilians decided their uniform was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但巴西人认定他们的队服是个问题。

sentences.en: So in 1953, the Brazilian soccer authorities set up a competition.
sentences.zh: 于是在1953年，巴西足球当局举办了一场设计大赛。

sentences.en: And advertised it in a national newspaper that's distributed all over Brazil.
sentences.zh: 并在全巴西发行的全国性报纸上进行了广告宣传。

sentences.en: They wanted people to write in with their designs for a new uniform.
sentences.zh: 他们希望人们投稿设计新的队服。

sentences.en: The contest had only one stipulation.
sentences.zh: 这场比赛只有一个规定。

sentences.en: The color of the uniform had to include all the colors of the Brazilian flag.
sentences.zh: 队服的颜色必须包含巴西国旗的所有颜色。

sentences.en: Green, blue, white and yellow.
sentences.zh: 绿色、蓝色、白色和黄色。

sentences.en: A design that would truly represent Brazil.
sentences.zh: 一个能够真正代表巴西的设计。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people entered the contest, including this guy.
sentences.zh: 数百人参加了比赛，其中包括这个人。

sentences.en: My name is Aldir Garcia Schley.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱伊。
zh_words: 阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱伊

sentences.en: And I'm from Jaguarão, on the border with Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 我来自与乌拉圭交界的雅瓜朗。

sentences.en: Aldir Garcia Schley.
sentences.zh: 阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱伊。
zh_words: 阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱伊

sentences.en: He was just 19 when he entered the competition.
sentences.zh: 他参加比赛时年仅19岁。

sentences.en: A young man who had grown up in a little town right on the border between Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 这个年轻人是在巴西和乌拉圭边境的一个小镇上长大的。

sentences.en: Schley wasn't a designer.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊并不是一名设计师。

sentences.en: He was working at a local newspaper as an illustrator.
sentences.zh: 他当时在当地的一家报社担任插画师。

sentences.en: He says when he first heard about the competition, he thought it would be too difficult.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他第一次听说这个比赛时，觉得太难了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the first impression I had was that this was foolish.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的第一印象是这太蠢了。

sentences.en: That was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 简直荒谬。

sentences.en: Because it's rare to have a team with four colors.
sentences.zh: 因为很少有一支球队采用四种颜色。

sentences.en: Working four colors into just the shirt would have been hard.
sentences.zh: 只在球衣里融入四种颜色是很困难的。

sentences.en: But eventually, Schley realized he could use the whole uniform to spread out the colors.
sentences.zh: 但最终，施莱伊意识到他可以利用整套队服来铺开这些颜色。

sentences.en: He tried blue shorts with a green shirt.
sentences.zh: 他尝试过蓝色短裤配绿色球衣。

sentences.en: A yellow and green striped shirt with white shorts.
sentences.zh: 黄绿相间的条纹球衣配白色短裤。

sentences.en: A green and yellow striped shirt with blue shorts.
sentences.zh: 绿黄相间的条纹球衣配蓝色短裤。

sentences.en: He came up with over 200 different designs.
sentences.zh: 他设计了200多种不同的方案。

sentences.en: Until eventually, he had it.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，他终于成功了。

sentences.en: Blue shorts, white socks, and a yellow shirt with green trim around the neck and the sleeves.
sentences.zh: 蓝色短裤、白色球袜，以及带有绿领和绿袖口的黄色球衣。

sentences.en: He sent the design off and a few weeks later, he looked down at the newspaper and saw his design staring back at him.
sentences.zh: 他寄出了设计方案，几周后，当他低头看着报纸时，发现自己的设计正印在上面凝视着他。

sentences.en: He had won.
sentences.zh: 他赢了。

sentences.en: After there, it was just a party.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，这里就成了一场派对。

sentences.en: My feet didn't touch the ground, and I was celebrating in the newsroom where I worked.
sentences.zh: 我的双脚仿佛腾空了，我在工作的报社新闻室里庆祝着。

sentences.en: It was like something impossible had just happened.
sentences.zh: 这就像刚刚发生了不可能的事情一样。

sentences.en: After he won, Schley got to bask in the glory of it all for a while.
sentences.zh: 获奖后，施莱伊享受了一段时间的荣耀。

sentences.en: He went to Rio, did an internship with the newspaper that had sponsored the conteSt.
sentences.zh: 他去了里约热内卢，在赞助此次比赛的报社实习。

sentences.en: He even lived with the Brazilian players for a few months.
sentences.zh: 他甚至和巴西球员们一起生活了几个月。

sentences.en: But eventually, he returned to his small town and kind of forgot about the shirt for a while.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他回到了自己的小镇，把球衣的事忘得差不多了。

sentences.en: But pretty soon, the shirt was Brazil.
sentences.zh: 不过很快，这件球衣就成了巴西的代名词。

sentences.en: In 1962, the Brazilians won the World Cup in Chile.
sentences.zh: 1962年，巴西人在智利赢得了世界杯。

sentences.en: And they were wearing Schley's uniform.
sentences.zh: 他们身上穿的就是施莱伊设计的队服。

sentences.en: Players like Pelé wore the yellow shirt and dazzled the world with their extraordinary skill and beauty.
sentences.zh: 像贝利这样的球员穿着黄色球衣，以他们非凡的球技和美感惊艳了世界。

sentences.en: Then color TV comes along, and the whole world can watch Brazil in brand new technicolor, like in the 1970 World Cup in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 接着彩色电视机普及了，全世界都可以通过全新的绚丽色彩观看巴西队的比赛，就像在1970年墨西哥世界杯上那样。

sentences.en: I was, you know, five when the 1970 World Cup was played, and I saw Brazil win the 70 World Cup in shimmering yellow shirts.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，1970年世界杯开赛时我五岁，我看到巴西队穿着波光粼粼的黄色球衣赢得了70年世界杯。

sentences.en: Here's soccer historian David Goldblatt again.
sentences.zh: 这位是足球历史学家大卫·戈德布拉特。

sentences.en: For me, you know, there's a memory there that I think lots of people have, even if they didn't see it, of, you know, of dazzle, of brilliance,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你知道的，那里有一种记忆，我想很多人都有，即使他们没有亲眼见过，那种惊艳，那种辉煌，

sentences.en: of amazing sort of global south sunshine, of flair.
sentences.zh: 那种惊叹的南半球阳光，那种天赋异禀。

sentences.en: Where Brazil had failed in 1950, the following years saw success after success.
sentences.zh: 正如巴西在1950年遭遇失败后，随后的几年里迎来了接二连三的成功。

sentences.en: They won World Cup after World Cup.
sentences.zh: 他们一届又一届地赢得世界杯。

sentences.en: Their yellow shirts becoming as much a hallmark as their intricate footwork and dazzling play.
sentences.zh: 他们的黄色球衣就像他们精湛的脚法和炫目的球技一样，成为了标志性的符号。

sentences.en: Schley's design became iconic.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊的设计成为了标志性的经典。

sentences.en: A symbol of Brazil.
sentences.zh: 巴西的象征。

sentences.en: Full of sun and life.
sentences.zh: 充满阳光与生命力。

sentences.en: But for Schley, life wasn't quite living up to the image of Brazil he had created.
sentences.zh: 但对于施莱伊来说，现实生活并没有完全达到他所创造的那个巴西形象的高度。

sentences.en: He started working as a writer and academic.
sentences.zh: 他开始从事作家和学者工作。

sentences.en: And in 1964, a brutal U.S.-backed military dictatorship took power in a coup.
sentences.zh: 1964年，一个残酷的、由美国支持的军事独裁政权通过政变夺取了政权。

sentences.en: Anti-Goulart demonstrations that greeted the now-deposed Brazilian president at Miami airport.
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密机场迎接现已被废黜的巴西总统的反古拉特游行。

sentences.en: The new military government cracked down on people it considered to be subversive, including academics.
sentences.zh: 新的军政府对他们认为具有颠覆性的人员进行了镇压，其中包括学者。

sentences.en: Like a lot of other professors and students, Schley was arrested for basically being on the political left.
sentences.zh: 和许多其他教授和学生一样，施莱伊因为基本上属于政治左翼而被捕。

sentences.en: When he got out of jail, he was expelled from his teaching job and was banned from leaving the country.
sentences.zh: 他出狱后，被驱逐出教职，并不准离开国家。

sentences.en: The dictatorship lasted for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 独裁统治持续了大约20年。

sentences.en: But despite the difficulties of living under the watchful eye of the military police,
sentences.zh: 但尽管在宪兵的严密监视下生活困难重重，

sentences.en: Schley became a successful writer, and he developed an academic specialty.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊成为了一名成功的作家，并发展了他的学术专长。

sentences.en: Schley has spent his life writing about the border between Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊一生都在书写巴西与乌拉圭的边境。

sentences.en: Schley was technically born in Brazil, but less than a mile from the border with Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊严格来说出生在巴西，但距离与乌拉圭的边境不到一英里。

sentences.en: In fact, when he was a kid, his father helped build a bridge across the river that separates Uruguay from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当他还是个孩子的时候，他的父亲曾协助修建横跨乌拉圭和巴西边界河流的桥梁。

sentences.en: Schley's experience growing up between two countries and his experiences under military rule have helped shape his feelings about Brazilian nationalism.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊在两个国家之间长大的经历以及在军事统治下的经历，塑造了他对巴西民族主义的看法。

sentences.en: Even though he designed a shirt that could be considered more patriotic than the Brazilian flag,
sentences.zh: 尽管他设计的球衣甚至可以被认为比巴西国旗更具爱国色彩，

sentences.en: he's actually very wary of patriotism.
sentences.zh: 但他实际上对爱国主义非常警惕。

sentences.en: It is an idea that competes with the ones that I have, to live without limits, live without borders.
sentences.zh: 这是一种与我的理念相冲突的想法，即无拘无束地生活，没有国界地生活。

sentences.en: Schley may not be a Brazilian patriot, but the soccer fan in him can't help but be proud of the Brazilian team.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊可能不是一个巴西爱国者，但他骨子里的球迷身份使他无法不对巴西队感到骄傲。

sentences.en: But Brazil won the championship five times.
sentences.zh: 但巴西五次赢得锦标赛冠军。

sentences.en: This is a source of pride.
sentences.zh: 这是自豪的源泉。

sentences.en: It's an honor for all of us.
sentences.zh: 这是我们所有人的荣耀。

sentences.en: But Schley has a secret, or at least something he never used to share with people who knew he was the designer of the famous yellow shirt.
sentences.zh: 但施莱伊有一个秘密，或者至少是有些事他从未对那些知道他是著名黄色球衣设计师的人分享过。

sentences.en: Schley roots for Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊支持乌拉圭。

sentences.en: For many in Brazil, this is blasphemy, but not for him.
sentences.zh: 对于许多巴西人来说，这简直是大逆不道，但对她而言并非如此。

sentences.en: We are one people, one border community.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个民族，一个边境社区。

sentences.en: Even if you have two languages, the people have only one cultural identity.
sentences.zh: 即使你有两种语言，人民也只有一个文化认同。

sentences.en: Schley feels culturally connected to both Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱伊在文化上与巴西和乌拉圭都有联系。

sentences.en: But he ultimately had to pick one country's team to root for.
sentences.zh: 但他最终必须选择支持其中一个国家的球队。

sentences.en: So, these days, when Brazil plays Uruguay, Schley, like a lot of other soccer fans, suits up in his favorite jersey.
sentences.zh: 所以，如今每当巴西对阵乌拉圭时，施莱伊就会像许多其他球迷一样，穿上他最喜欢的球衣。

sentences.en: But not the yellow shirt he designed, a sky blue one, the color of Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 但不是他设计的黄色球衣，而是一件天蓝色的、代表乌拉圭颜色的球衣。

sentences.en: Then he crosses the border from Brazil to Uruguay and finds some quiet bar to watch the game.
sentences.zh: 然后他跨越从巴西到乌拉圭的边境，找一家安静的酒吧观看比赛。

sentences.en: We'd like to thank Alex Belos for his help.
sentences.zh: 我们要感谢亚历克斯·贝洛斯的帮助。

sentences.en: Alex was the first English journalist to write about this story and helped point us in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是第一位报道这个故事的英国记者，并帮我们指明了正确的方向。

sentences.en: Junior Maza and Fabio Aranaldi also have fixed everything up in Brazil and translated our interview with Schley.
sentences.zh: 儒尼奥尔·马扎和法比奥·阿拉纳尔迪还在巴西安排了一切，并翻译了我们对施莱伊的采访。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，制作于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心的Radio Row。

sentences.en: You can find the show and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到这个节目并参与讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me, at Roman Mars, and the show at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上@我，@RomanMars，以及节目@99PI.org。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and have a nice subreddit, too.
sentences.zh: 我们在Instagram和Tumblr上都有账号，也有一个不错的subreddit社区。

sentences.en: But this week, we have two articles by Kurt about the naming, numbering, and categorization of colors on our website.
sentences.zh: 但本周，我们在网站上有两篇库尔特关于颜色命名、编号和分类的文章。

sentences.en: It's 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99PI.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: 放射乌托邦。
